description: Recommend Seattle hotels for a stay with the whole-trip cost: typical room rate for the nights plus the rides the stay needs (Seatac → hotel on check-in day, then hotel → cruise pier or back to Seatac on check-out day). near is a cruise pier (pier-66, pier-91: check-out day is sailing day) or a hotel area. For a pier it also prices a SeaTac airport hotel, so the traveler can see when a cheaper airport room plus rides beats a downtown room. Room links lead; ride links are the add-on. Typical rates and ride estimates, not live prices.

checkout.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD (sailing day for a pier).

compare_airport_hotel.description: For a pier: also price a SeaTac airport hotel (default true).

near.description: A cruise pier (pier-66, pier-91) or a hotel area.

name: recommend_hotels_with_rides
title: Hotels with whole-trip ride costs
